name: Sozdanie modov s Samantoj 2022
source:
In this small guide, Samantha will teach you how to create mods for [url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url]. She will try to explain everything as clearly and concisely as possible, with the hope that you, reader, will be able to bring your ideas to life.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2751482551]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这个小指南中，Samantha将教你如何为 [url=/v3126]Beskonechnoe leto[/url] 创建模组。她将尽力尽可能清晰、简洁地解释一切，希望读者能够将你的想法变为现实。
